doc.toml:
reflex = 1

description = """
Roll a service back from a release to the one before it.
Everywhere at once."""
not_for = ["listing deploys", "moving a meeting"]
tags    = ["rollback"]
effect  = "destructive"
confirm = "Roll back {release}?"
run     = "rollback.mts"

[args.release]
ask    = "From which release?"
pick   = "code"
recent = "release"

[examples]
"roll checkout back from 4.12.0" = { release = "4.12.0" }

ok.description:
Roll a service back from a release to the one before it.
Everywhere at once.
